programme.desc: Por la presecución del Rey Herodés de Judea, el niño Jesús y sus padres Maria y José huyen por el desierto de Egipto, donde el niño aprende sus primeras letras, culminando con al iniciacíon de su vida secreta.

programme.desc: When Donna speaks her mind one too many times for Ceaser's liking, he sends her packing. A customer appreciation (aka mixxxy) field trip to a water park ends in fireworks when Sky finds out that Ted has been messing around. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Don freaks out after Ashley gives him news. Lily and Cobra come to blows. Van struggles to deal with the fallout from his breakup. When Ryan throws a party for Bone Thugs-n-Harmony, Charmaine seizes an opportunity to get her job back. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Ryan returns to the shop after a major health scare. JR learns disturbing information about his relationship with Lily. Phor questions his career as a tattoo artist. And Lily takes down Cobra after she meddles in her relationship. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: A Father and Son initially enjoy their experiences, but a sudden snowstorm wreaks havoc and they are forced to spend a night in a cave without any supplies or food.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: Lost in the rain forest Join jungle guide Myke Hawke in the Amazon as he wrestles anacondas, spots deadly poisons, and tries to survive and make it out alive.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: A treasure hunter gets lost in the Australian Outback and struggles to survive wild dingoes.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: An ER Miracle
programme.desc: A young boy is taken to the ER after being in a horrific accident. His head is severed and doctors race to save his life.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER
programme.desc: A paralyzed stroke patient watches speechless and horrified as his wife and his 2 girlfriends fight over him; Army doctors in Iraq try to save the lives of 3 soldiers who lost limbs in an IED explosion.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: I Can't Remember
programme.desc: A patient can't remember the past 20 years, but in order to treat her, her doctor desperately needs to know what she's forgotten. After reviving his cardiac arrest victim, a doctor packs him in ice, hoping to preserve his brain function.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: The murder of a man inside his suburban Los Angeles home sets off a chain reaction of murder, conspiracy, and furious cover ups, which ultimately point back to a mastermind who's in it for the money.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: A look at a wayward son who goes on a shooting spree, killing five people from two families.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: The disappearance of a decorated military man stumps law enforcement and shocks a central Texas community.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: A teen mom and her new husband concoct a plan to kill an innocent man they meet on Craigslist. The end result is a vicious stabbing that sends shockwaves through a small Pennsylvania community.

programme.title: I Lived with a Killer
programme.desc: William Choyce's ex-wife and daughter are grateful to be alive after living with a serial killer.

programme.title: I Lived with a Killer
programme.desc: Michael Bear Carson and his wife, Suzan, leave a trail of death when they set out to kill witches.

programme.title: Couples Therapy
programme.desc: Marjorie & Jason clash; a breach upends Sienna & Chris. Season premiere.

programme.title: Couples Therapy
programme.desc: Chris admits infidelities; Clinton's meltdown leads Orna to seek advice.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Dr. G must determine if a teen boy died by taking his own life, but the autopsy leads to a more shocking and tragic conclusion.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: Two fathers and their son's fishing trip in Mexico turns bad when they find themselves forced to ditch their plane in the sea during a storm.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: Divorcee Mathew McGough is taking his five-year-old daughter Shannon for an overnight camping trip.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: In June 1996, a group of 5 teenage scouts and 3 adult guides hiked into the Grand Canyon during a heatwave; the route was an off-trail route in the vicinity of the Nankoweap Trail.

programme.title: Sex, Lies & Murder
programme.desc: Investigators uncover a wolf in sheep's clothing when Anna Lisa Raymundo is murdered.

programme.title: Equilibrium (ESP)
programme.desc: En el futuro, la humanidad ha prohibido cosas que producen emociones como la literatura, la música y el arte, para mantenerlo, un grupo especial de policías eliminará a los transgresores. Christian Bale protagoniza esta increíble película de acción.

programme.title: Hostage
programme.desc: Un negociador de la policía fracasado que se convierte en un oficial de una pequeña ciudad debe salvar a una familia secuestrada, lo que lo conduce a una situación muy peligrosa.

programme.title: El duelo
programme.desc: Un ranger de Texas investiga una serie de muertes inexplicables en un pueblo llamado Helena.

programme.title: Los últimos caballeros
programme.desc: Clive Owen stars in this epic, sword-clashing adventure about a fallen warrior battling to avenge his dishonored master (Morgan Freeman).

programme.title: Actos de venganza
programme.desc: Un abogado de hablar rápido (Antonio Banderas) transforma su cuerpo y toma un voto de silencio, que no se romperá hasta que descubra quién mató a su esposa e hija y tenga su venganza.

programme.title: Atrapen al gringo
programme.desc: Un criminal de carrera, capturado por las autoridades mexicanas, es enviado a una prisión de alta seguridad donde aprende a sobrevivir con la ayuda de un niño

programme.title: 13 horas: los soldados secretos de Bengasi
programme.desc: Del director Michael Bay, 13 horas es la historia de un grupo élite de seis exmilitares asignados para proteger a la CIA, que lucharon cuando los terroristas atacaron un complejo diplomático estadounidense el 11 de septiembre de 2012.

programme.title: El mensajero

programme.title: Pandemia lupina

programme.title: Resucitados

programme.title: Los usurpadores de cuerpos

programme.title: Victor Crowley

programme.title: Wardens

programme.title: Wardens

programme.title: Wardens

programme.title: Wardens

programme.title: Wardens

programme.title: 72 Hours: Hunted

programme.sub-title: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake

programme.title: South Park: Chinpokomon
programme.desc: Chinpokomon: Stan, Cartman, and Kenny are caught up in the latest fad from Japan, a cartoon called Chinpokomon - but what is the secret plan behind the show's anti-American sentiments...? (S3, E11)

programme.title: South Park: Starvin' Marvin In Space
programme.desc: Starvin' Marvin In Space: Marvin is back! He and the boys travel around the world in an alien spaceship on a food-gathering mission, hotly pursued by the CIA and Sally Struthers. (S3, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Korn's Groovy Pirate Ghost Mystery
programme.desc: Korn's Groovy Pirate Ghost Mystery: The boys are being plagued by the 5th graders and South Park is overrun by Pirate Ghosts. Nu-Metal band Korn must save the day! (Scooby-Doo parody). (S3, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Hooked on Monkey Fonics
programme.desc: Hooked on Monkey Fonics: The boys compete against a couple of home schooled kids in South Park's annual spelling bee. (S3, E12)

programme.title: South Park: The Red Badge of Gayness
programme.desc: The Red Badge of Gayness: Cartman bets the boys he can win a Civil War re-enactment leading the Confederates. When things don't go to plan it's time for a booze fuelled rampage! (S3, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankey's Christmas Classics
programme.desc: Mr. Hankey's Christmas Classics: Join Mr Hankey as he hosts his own variety show from infront of the fire in his sewer home. Features unusual holiday songs such as "Christmas Time In Hell". (S3, E15)

programme.title: South Park: Are You There God? It's Me, Jesus
programme.desc: Are You There God, It's Me Jesus: Cartman claims to be going through puberty, making the boys jealous, and Jesus promises a New Year's Eve spectacle - so books Rod Stewart to play Las Vegas! (S3, E16)
programme.sub-title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jesus

programme.title: South Park: Worldwide Recorder Concert
programme.desc: Worldwide Recorder Concert: The class visit Mr Garrison's hometown for a recorder concert, where they attempt to find the mysterious 'brown noise'. What part does Kenny G play in this? (S3, E17)

programme.desc: A U.S. rendition flight crash-lands in rural Quebec, and ICS must recapture three terrorists before the Americans forcibly intervene.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.desc: El ganador del Globo de Oro Peter Fonda protagoniza esta mini serie de ciencia ficción distópica. Un astrofísico determina que el sol está listo para explotar y que el final de la civilización es una posibilidad real.

programme.title: Ahora estamos solos
programme.desc: En un futuro no muy lejano, algo dejó al planeta devastado. Durante mucho tiempo, De se considera el último representante de la humanidad. Acostumbrado a la soledad, casi se siente feliz con la tranquilidad de los dias.

programme.title: Donnie Darko
programme.desc: Un adolescente con problemas tiene visiones de un hombre con un gran traje de conejo que lo manipula para cometer una serie de crímenes, después de que escapa por poco de un extraño accidente.

programme.title: Abominable
programme.desc: Un hombre, lisiado en un accidente de escalada, regresa a su cabaña en el bosque como parte de su rehabilitación, pero no estaba preparado para el ataque inminente.

programme.title: Underworld
programme.desc: Selene, una guerrera vampiro, está inmersa en un conflicto entre vampiros y hombres lobo, mientras se enamora de Michael, un humano que es buscado por hombres lobo por razones desconocidas.

programme.title: Los hambrientos
programme.desc: En un remoto pueblo de Canadá, un virus afecta a la mayoría de sus habitantes transformándolos en unos zombis hambrientos de carne humana.

programme.title: Yo, Frankenstein
programme.desc: La criatura de Frankenstein se encuentra atrapada en una guerra total de siglos de antigüedad entre dos clanes inmortales.

programme.title: Apocalipsis Alienígena: ¿Podría Sobrevivir la Humanidad?
programme.desc: Muchas películas imaginan invasiones alienígenas con finales heroicos donde la humanidad vence. Pero en un escenario real, ¿tendríamos alguna oportunidad contra una civilización extraterrestre superior, avanzada y decidida a conquistar toda la Tierra hoy?

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Crocosaurus
programme.desc: El enorme tiburón prehistórico ha sobrevivido a la última batalla, y el mundo se ve amenazado nuevamente cuando se descubre un enemigo nuevo y más peligroso en las selvas de África.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La fe es una fuerza poderosa. Puede proporcionar fuerza a los débiles. Puede calmar los mares más tempestuosos. Pero, para la mayoría de las personas, la fe brinda respuestas que pueden ayudar a darle sentido a un mundo caótico.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La infancia debería ser una etapa de descubrimiento lúdico y de regocijo inocente. ¿Pero qué sucede cuando las realidades del reino paranormal traspasan sus barreras y despiertan el mal verdadero?

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Los investigadores paranormales buscan comprender lo sobrenatural y, con frecuencia, utilizan su conocimiento para ayudar a los demás. Pero, ¿qué ocurre con estos expertos cuando el objeto de sus estudios se vuelve contra ellos?

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Incluso los lugares más inofensivos pueden guardar las cicatrices de un pasado retorcido. El mal puede perdurar a través del tiempo, puede permanecer latente hasta que alguna persona ingenua, o algún inocente, se crucen en su camino sin darse cuenta.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El nacimiento y la muerte son etapas naturales de la vida. Sin embargo, algunas veces la muerte no es el capítulo final... A menudo, espíritus inquietos deambulan por la tierra buscando golpear con su furia eterna a los vivos.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Ayudar a los amigos a sobrellevar los tiempos difíciles puede ser agotador, en especial cuando esa dificultad tiene que ver con una enfermedad que pone en peligro la vida.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuenta la leyenda que un "fantasma" empujará a cualquiera que se atreva a sentarse en lo alto del mausoleo en el cementerio más antiguo de Wisconsin. Los compañeros de secundaria Nick, Krystian y Jon prueban esta teoría en la noche de Halloween.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En Maryland, la casa de Kathie Sheats, una madre soltera, es acosada por un demonio. Los psíquicos, los sacerdotes y los investigadores paranormales no logran resolver el problema.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Chris Gibbons y su familia se mudan a la casa de sus sueños... que se convierte en una pesadilla. Una extraña combinación de sueños aterradores y avistamientos de fantasmas obligan a Chris a luchar contra lo sobrenatural.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En Michigan, la familia Johnson encuentra la que creen su casa perfecta, pero resulta estar embrujada y un demonio intenta poseer a su hijo. Sólo el poder de la oración puede devolver la paz y la cordura.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Jamie y Aaron, nativos de Carolina del Norte, viven un estilo de vida sureño "perfecto"... hasta que una entidad oscura comienza a aterrorizar a sus hijos. A riesgo de exponerse a las burlas, contactan a expertos paranormales para que los rescaten.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Bob Baker, un investigador paranormal de Connecticut, pide ayuda a sus colegas y a un obispo porque la casa de su madre está embrujada. Como no logran limpiar la casa, Bob tiene que recurrir a su propio pasado "embrujado" para hacer el trabajo.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La familia VanLandingham se muda a Arkansas y sus jóvenes hijas sufren un ataque sobrenatural de entidades oscuras. Los esfuerzos de un Pastor y un investigador paranormal para liberarlas son en vano, así que deciden abandonar la casa de sus sueños.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La histórica Casa de los Allen, en Arkansas, está encantada. Mark y Rebecca Spencer lo sabían cuando la compraron. Investigan la causa del embrujo, descubren el pasado secreto de la casa y a un anterior propietario que se suicidó.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Lynn y Jason Ryder compran un histórico restaurante en Connecticut, pero son invadidos por las fuerzas del mal y empleados y clientes son atacados. Investigadores, médiums y clarividentes son llamados para librar al restaurante de su pasado demoníaco.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cindy Sauer intenta superar la repentina muerte de su marido cuando sombras oscuras y pesadillas la convencen de que un demonio la persigue a ella y a su familia.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Victoria Dane, de Nuevo México, despierta de una experiencia cercana a la muerte y descubre que está siendo atacada por una entidad demoníaca.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Un hombre se enamora de una mujer casada y le arranca un mechón de amenazándola con lanzarle un hechizo para alejarla de su marido. Poco después, un espíritu demoníaco comienza a aterrorizar a la pareja

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Mark Corvo tiene un don espiritual que podría costarle la vida. Regresa a vivir en la casa de su infancia y allí se enfrenta a fuerzas oscuras que intentan matarlo. Los investigadores paranormales descubren que se ha abierto un portal en la casa.

programme.title: El Karateca Azteca
programme.desc: Capulina ayuda a un arqueólogo alemán y a su guapa hija, Nadia a visitar ruinas arqueológicas. Una banda de contrabandistas de piezas arqueológicas atrapa al padre de Nadia. Capulina combate a los malhechores con sus artes marciales.

programme.title: El Metiche
programme.desc: Capulina es un metiche que causa peores problemas a la gente que los que ellos tienen antes de que Capulina trata de ayudarlos.

programme.title: El Rey de Monterrey
programme.desc: Capulina y su novia, la sirvienta en una casa rica, deciden dar un paseo usando el automóvil de los patrones. Una banda de roba coches les roban el auto. Capulina y su novia tienen que recuperar el auto antes de que sus patrones se enteren.

programme.title: El Sargento Capulina
programme.desc: Capulina quiere convertirse en superhéroe para combatir el crimen. Se enlista en la policía y después de un riguroso entrenamiento llega a ser sargento y confronta a los criminales en una serie de incidentes cómicos.

programme.title: El bueno para nada
programme.desc: Todos tachaban de torpe al pobre Capulina, ah, pero bien que lo buscan para desactivar la máquina que hizo un científico para destruir el mundo.

programme.title: El circo de Capulina
programme.desc: Capulina viaja a Monterrey para trabajar en un circo y ayudar a su sobrina a recuperar un terreno que ha heredado, el cual esconde un tesoro enterrado por un coronel revolucionario.

programme.title: El médico módico
programme.desc: El mecánico de las ambulancias de un hospital habla de su oficio en términos médicos. En el hospital atiende a un delincuente pero éste sale huyendo provocando confusión y un relajo en todo el hospital.

programme.title: La cigüeña distraída
programme.desc: Un empresario rico y un ranchero humilde confunden a sus gemelos recién nacidos al ir por ellos al hospital y se genera una gran confusión.

programme.title: Los Desenfrenados
programme.desc: Viruta y Capulina son dos camioneros y conocen a unas hermosas fugitivas que huyen de un internado femenino.

programme.title: Los Legionarios
programme.desc: Viruta y Capulina huyen disfrazados de mujer de la legión extranjera, pero los confunden con esclavas y son vendidos para el harem del príncipe Omar. La odalisca Farida los descubre y avisa al sultán, quien los manda a decapitar.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman decide entrar en el negocio de la venta de fetos abortados. Por otro lado, Kenny contrae una enfermedad muscular mortal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Es un episodio de South Park dedicado a Butters para cerrar la temporada. La madre descubre que su esposo visita lugares gay y entonces trata de suicidarse y matar a Butters.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Ya que Butters parece encajar tan bien con Cartman, Kyle y Stan, sus padres deciden ir todos juntos a Aspen en un tiempo compartido.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Luego de haber bajado de peso comiendo sándwiches de Subway, Jared se hizo muy famoso, pero nadie sabe que lo logró gracias a sus ayudantes, Elviro y Positivo. Al ver esto, los chicos tratan de hacer lo mismo con Butters.
programme.sub-title: El avance de la película de Terrance y Philip

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La clase va de visita a una granja en donde se enteran que ''ternera'' es una vaquita bebé y quedan horrorizados (excepto Cartman). Entonces, deciden salvar a las terneras de ser matadas y las secuestran.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos le dicen a Butters que es aburrido y que no puede ocupar el lugar de Kenny. El despecho de Butters hace que éste descubra un lado oscuro de sí mismo que ni él sabía que existía: el Profesor Caos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se entusiasma con unas criaturas marinas que puede criar en su propia habitación. Mientras tanto, el Profesor Caos, regresa con un montón de nuevos y malvados planes para sembrar el caos en South Park.
programme.sub-title: Los Simpson ya lo han hecho

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un caso de abusos sexuales en el que hay sacerdotes implicados escandaliza South Park, y es llevado ante el Vaticano. Mientras tanto, Cartman intenta descubrir qué cosas son capaces de salir de su boca.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos quieren armar un club para evitar que los directores renueven sus películas y a Cartman se le ocurre que, para atraer a más gente, ofrezcan sombreros gratis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Bebe es la primera niña a la que les crecen las tetas y los chicos del grado, sin saber por qué, se vuelven locos por ella.
programme.sub-title: Las tetas de Bebe destruyen la sociedad

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Luego de muchas noticias sobre secuestros infantiles y de un intento de secuestro a Tweek, los padres de South Park están muy preocupados y se les ocurre construir una gran muralla alrededor del pueblo.
programme.sub-title: El secuestro infantil no tiene gracia

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos ganan muchos dulces en un concurso, pero para reclamar el premio necesitan el cupón ganador el cual le dieron a Kenny antes de morir.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos juegan a ''El Señor De Los Anillos'' y tratan de recuperar un video porno que sus padres le dieron confundiendo las cintas. Pero en el camino tendrán que escapar de los chicos más grandes y de Butters.
programme.sub-title: El regreso del Señor a las Dos Torres

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan toca la marihuana que otros chicos mayores dejaron y, por la noche, llega un hombre que dice ser él mismo a los 32 años quién vuelve del futuro, perdido y drogado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle 1, el contador de Cartman, le dice que si quiere recibir un regalo de Santa este año, tiene que hacer algo muy bueno antes de navidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos se unen a una protesta anti-bélica, sólo para poder salir antes de la escuela. Mientras tanto, South Park está dividido en dos grupos: los que están a favor de la guerra y los que no lo están.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando una reciente estrella discapacitada visita South Park y roba el protagonismo de Jimmy, él y Timmy pelean contra eso formando una pandilla de discapacitados.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Para vengarse de la profesora de arte, los chicos cubren su casa con papel higiénico. Cartman considera matar a Kyle para que él no los delate.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El impacto es mundial cuando los visitantes regresan a South Park y los chicos descubren que la Tierra es un enorme reality show intergaláctico.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La verdadera "Jenny from the block" se enfurece cuando una de las partes del cuerpo de Cartman se hace demasiado famosa por sus propios medios.
programme.sub-title: Culo gordo y cabeza de panqueuqe

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos juegan a ser detectives y realizan un buen trabajo resolvendo pequeños misterios locales. Tanto así que la policía los llama para felicitarlos y darles casos verdaderos y peligrosos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Obligados a salir de su tierra por los propietarios del "Casino Indio Tres Plumas", los chicos organizan a South Park para pelear contra los ricos y poderosos Indios.
programme.sub-title: La codicia del hombre de piel roja

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos son candidatos para ser gays una vez que la locura metrosexual llega a South Park, y el señor Garrison acusa a los chicos de "Queer eye" de venderse.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman llega a los mejores lugares de las listas de éxitos con su propia banda cristiana de rock, y los chicos son arrestados por bajar música de internet.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Jimmy y Timmy entrenan para participar en las Olimpiadas Especiales y Jimmy acepta esteroides que le ofrece Nathan. Mientras, Cartman se disfraza para convencer a un comité calificado de que él es discapacitado y así ganar el premio.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.desc: El primo de Kyle, también llamado Kyle, llega de visita desde Connecticut, ya que su madre está enferma. A pesar de ser de la misma edad, los primos no tienen nada en común.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle han sido capturados por el Pentágono para que le digan al gobierno exactamente cómo entraron a "Imaginaciónlandia". Mientras tanto, Cartman no se da por vencido en su apuesta con Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El show de Cartman es tendencia, mientras que el país se prepara para vivir la fiesta mas espectacular jamás vista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle quiere jugar a los videojuegos con su hermano menor. Pero cuando Ike no quiere jugar más con él, Kyle teme que la próxima generación lo haya superado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey es despedido de la escuela por perder una hoja de marihuana durante una presentación en contra de las drogas. Entretanto, los chicos tratan de salvar a Ike de su fiesta ''bris'' en donde le harán la circuncisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman ha logrado “la paz mundial” gracias a una de sus bromas para humillar a Kyle. Este acontecimiento reúne a miles de líderes religiosos de todo el mundo en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los japoneses están realizando ataques con el fin de aniquilar a todos los delfines y ballenas del planeta. Ante esta situación, Stan decide toma medidas para detener la matanza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle se enoja con sus padres por no dejarlo ir al concierto de los Raging Pussies, y Cartman le recomienda que le diga a la policía que sus padres lo masturbaron para que los arresten.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una apuesta iniciada porque Cartman vio a un duende es el inicio de un problema, aunado a que los chicos se encuentran frente a la totalidad imaginativa del mundo atacada por un grupo terrorista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se considera el crítico número uno en Internet de restaurantes en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos intentan cruzar al elefante de Kyle con ''Fofa'', la cerda de Cartman, para un experimento genético de la escuela con el cual intentan ganarle a Terrance. Mientras, Stan lucha contra los abusos físicos de su hermana, Shelly.
programme.sub-title: Un elefante hace el amor con una cerda

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman consigue ganar dinero subiendo videos de unos bebés peleando por una pelotita de crack. Kyle piensa que eso es malo hasta que Cartman lo convence de que no es así.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le insiste a sus amigos que los ataques terroristas del 11 de Septiembre fueron una conspiración y se dispone a desenmascarar la verdad. Por su parte, el Sr. Mackey quiere saber quién defecó en el baño.
programme.sub-title: El misterio del mojón en el urinal

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Señor Garrison ha decidido hacerse un cambio de sexo y ahora se siente como una verdadera mujer. Mientras tanto, Kyle quiere hacerse una cirugía para ser negro y poder jugar en el equipo de básquetbol.
programme.sub-title: La nueva vagina del Señor Garrison

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un día de diversión en el parque acuático se torna mortal para los niños.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Nueva Jersey se está expandiendo rápidamente y South Park está en peligro de convertirse en la siguiente ciudad en ser invadida. Randy y los chicos intentarán evitarlo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una nueva alumna llega a la escuela primaria de South Park y es negra por lo que Cartman cree que debería hacer pareja con Token, y no dejará que nadie se interponga en el camino, en especial Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos encuentran un antiguo objeto triangular en una excavación escolar. Luego de salir en el noticiero, Barbra Streisand aparece buscándolo ya que es lo que necesita para poder convertirse en un monstruo gigante japonés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle está muy enfermo y su madre trata de curarlo con medicinas naturales de una curandera y sus colaboradores "nativos americanos”. Mientras, el señor Garrison es despedido y se convierte en un escritor de novelas románticas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy propone un plan para arreglar la situación económica mundial. Mientras tanto, Stan intenta devolver una máquina para hacer margaritas, y un salvador inesperado hace el último sacrificio para resolver los problemas de todos.

programme.title: Headhunters
programme.desc: Un reclutador corporativo, quien también se dedica a robar arte, planea robar una pintura valiosa del candidato perfecto para un trabajo vacante.

programme.title: Nunca es tarde para enamorarse
programme.desc: Narra la historia de Harvey (Dustin Hoffman), un hombre aburrido y cansado, que viaja a Londres para asistir a la boda de su hija con un hombre bastante mayor que ella. Allí, Harvey conocerá a una mujer (Emma Thompson) que le cambiará la vida.

programme.title: Fillers Pluto TV ES
programme.desc: Fillers Pluto TV

programme.title: Melancolía
programme.desc: Con motivo de su matrimonio, Justine y Michael dan una suntuosa recepción en la casa de la hermana de Justine y de su cuñado. Mientras tanto, el planeta Melancholia se dirige hacia la Tierra.

programme.title: Tipos Legales
programme.desc: Val (Al Pacino) sale de la cárcel tras cumplir 28 años de condena. Doc (Christopher Walken), su mejor amigo, le espera a la salida para ir a ver a Hirsch (Alan Arkin), otro viejo colega.

programme.title: El intruso
programme.desc: Tras un trágico accidente, un hombre se convierte en el objetivo de la peligrosa obsesión de otro testigo.

programme.title: La casa de la esperanza
programme.desc: La mujer del guardián del zoo cuenta la historia de los guardianes del zoo de Varsovia, Jan y Antonina Zabinski, que ayudaron a salvar a cientos de personas y animales durante la invasión nazi.

programme.title: 1492: La conquista del paraíso
programme.desc: Retrata la vida del atrevido explorador Cristóbal Colón. Un difícil y sorprendente viaje hasta una tierra desconocida por el mundo, América; el efecto sobre las tribus indígenas y la vuelta del héroe a España hasta su muerte.

programme.title: Hitler: El ascenso del mal - Parte 2
programme.desc: Una perspectiva única, que perfila la vida de Adolf Hitler como un niño y su ascenso a través de las filas del Partido Nacional Alemán de los Trabajadores antes de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: La carretera
programme.desc: Basado en la espléndida novela que ganó el premio Pulitzer en 2007. La película nos introduce en un mundo apocalíptico, arrasado por una explosión nuclear, en el cual un padre y su hijo viajan hacia la costa para buscar un lugar seguro donde vivir.

programme.title: 24 Hours
programme.desc: Un equipo SWAT debe detener a un terrorista que quiere matar rehenes y destruir Los Ángeles en solo 24 horas.

programme.title: Reset
programme.desc: Tras el secuestro de su hijo, la inventora de una máquina del tiempo reúne a varias versiones de su futuro yo para rescatarlo.

programme.title: Monter's Battlefield
programme.desc: Ye Qin, la prometida del rey soldado Qin Yang, murió trágicamente frente a una bestia gigante desconocida. Gu Ping lo invitó a participar en la investigación de Ye Qin durante su vida.

programme.title: Valentine: venganza oscura
programme.desc: Una joven se involucra con un hombre con la idea de que va a hacer una película cuando lo que él pretende es convertirla en vigilante enmascarada.

programme.title: Más Allá De La Onda Expansiva
programme.desc: Un artificiero inculpado decide escapar de la vigilancia policial para tratar de descubrir la verdad

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Tres amigos se ven obligados a separarse tras un atraco frustrado. Ocho años más tarde, el destino los vuelve a unir a pesar de haber tomado caminos muy distintos.

programme.title: El heredero del billón de dólares
programme.desc: Guido Falcone tiene que viajar, dentro de veinte días, a San Francisco desde su Italia natal para reclamar su herencia de un billón de dólares.

programme.title: Las nuevas aventuras de Aladino
programme.desc: Dos empleados fracasados de unos grandes almacenes planean robar la tienda tras el cierre. Pero cuando un grupo de niños aparece pidiendo una historia, los hombres improvisan y empiezan a contar su propia versión del cuento de Aladino.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: James Hunt y Niki Lauda, dos pilotos de Fórmula 1 extremadamente hábiles, mantienen entre sí una intensa rivalidad. Sin embargo, es su enemistad lo que les lleva al límite.

programme.title: Un tipo de altura
programme.desc: El "largo" Dexter King, tímido y torpe, es el hombro de un comediante que trabaja en Drury Lane. Alérgico a las plumas, Dexter, a quien un médico le ha recetado una serie de inyecciones, conoce a la enfermera Kate y se enamora de ella.

programme.title: Will You Merry Me
programme.desc: After Rebecca and Henry get engaged, they gather their families for the holidays to surprise them with the good news. But will their clashing families ever get along?

programme.title: 3 Holiday Tails
programme.desc: David and Lisa are meant to be together, but they haven't figured that out yet! With help from family, friends, and four lovable dogs, this couple will truly have a Christmas to remember.

programme.title: Nicky Deuce
programme.desc: Nicholas es enviado a vivir con su abuela y su tío a Brooklyn durante el verano, pero tras atender una llamada telefónica el decide emprender una gran transformación personal y se convertirá en Nicky Deuce para llevar a cabo una misteriosa misión.

programme.title: Atrapada en San Valentin
programme.desc: Después de la peor cita de San Valentín de su vida, Katherine vuelve de camino a su casa cuando una gitana le lanza un hechizo. A la mañana siguiente, se dará cuenta de que está reviviendo el mismo día.

programme.title: Papa Moll & The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: El caos se apodera de la casa el único fin de semana que el Señor Moll se queda solo al cuidado de los niños. Mientras él trabaja, los niños comienzan una pelea con los niños del vecino. Una lucha de chocolatinas, tareas para el cole y un Perro Circense.

programme.title: Pettson & Findus
programme.desc: El señor Pettson vive en una pequeña casa, cortando madera, haciendo trabajos peculiares, trabajando en sus inventos, pescando, y cuidando de sus gallinas. Parece que tiene todo en orden hasta que su vecina le da un pequeño gato para que le haga compañía.

programme.title: Mi Amigo Raffi
programme.desc: Sammy, de ocho años, tiene pequeño roedor que no es un hamster cualquiera: no sólo puede jugar al fútbol sino que también puede detectar materiales de contrabando. Un día Raffi desaparece pero nadie tiempo para ayudarle a buscarlo.

programme.title: Storm y la carta prohibida de Lutero
programme.desc: Storm Voeten, hijo del copista Klaas Voeten, se convierte en la diana de una cacería de la Inquisición. Ayudado por Marieke, una misteriosa chica que vive en las cloacas de Antwerp, Storm es capturado en una carrera contrarreloj para salvar a su padre.

programme.title: Tapas
programme.desc: Varias historias se entrelazan en un barrio de trabajadores de una gran ciudad.

programme.title: Dinosaurios
programme.desc: Tres niños que viajan en el tiempo 65 millones de años atrás, donde son recogidos por una mamá dinosaurio.

programme.title: Los Abandonados
programme.desc: Marie vuelve a una vieja granja de la Rusia rural que acaba de heredar de una madre a la que nunca conoció y que ha muerto en extrañas circunstancias. Aislada en una casa abandonada , Marie descubrirá en ella a Nikolai.

programme.title: Prácticamente muerto
programme.desc: Tras el asesinato de un líder supremacista, su viuda busca venganza con la ayuda de dos fanáticos, que secuestran y torturan a un hombre al que creen responsable.

programme.title: Mi obsesión por Rachel
programme.desc: Rachel inicia una relación con Craig, un hombre encantador que irrumpe en su vida con un romanticismo inesperado. Todo parece perfecto… hasta que su verdadera personalidad comienza a salir a la luz.

programme.title: El intruso
programme.desc: Tras un trágico accidente, un hombre se convierte en el objetivo de la peligrosa obsesión de otro testigo.

programme.title: El tercer asesinato
programme.desc: El conocido abogado Shigemori defiende a Misumi, acusado de robo con homicidio, que ya cumplió pena de cárcel por otro asesinato hace treinta años.

programme.title: Capricornio Uno
programme.desc: El primer viaje a Marte presenciado mundialmente es en realidad un simulacro. Los tres astronautas designados para la misión se ven obligados a participar en la farsa, hasta que un técnico de la NASA decide investigar.

programme.title: Picnic en Hanging Rock
programme.desc: San Valentín de 1900, las estudiantes de la Escuela Appleyard van de excursión a Hanging Rock, una región montañosa. A lo largo del día se producen una serie de fenómenos sobrenaturales. Dirigida por Peter Weir (Master and Commander).

programme.title: Moebius
programme.desc: En un futuro no muy lejano, un misterioso accidente ocurre en el metro de Buenos Aires: un coche que circulaba por la vía desaparece, perdiéndose en el tiempo debido a un extraño fenómeno que solo un científico puede resolver.

programme.title: Cuatro vidas
programme.desc: La película se Basa en un proverbio chino según el cual la existencia humana se divide en cuatro emociones: felicidad, placer, pena y amor. Estas emociones acaban cruzándose a través de cuatro personajes.

programme.title: El intruso
programme.desc: Tras un trágico accidente, un hombre se convierte en el objetivo de la peligrosa obsesión de otro testigo.

programme.title: El sustituto
programme.desc: Un exmarine se infiltra como profesor sustituto y descubre que una banda está aterrorizando al instituto. Como hay vidas amenazadas, se propone limpiarlo de delincuentes.

programme.title: El secreto del lago
programme.desc: Un adolescente descubre un oscuro secreto que desata una peligrosa cadena de acontecimientos.

programme.title: Fillers Pluto TV ES
programme.desc: Fillers Pluto TV ES

programme.title: Invencible

After their bodies are retrieved, they are placed into a secret program in which they are reanimated and trained to become unquestioning killing machines. While Deveraux and Scott initially have no memory of their former lives, glimpses of their pasts start to return, rekindling their intense conflict.

programme.title: Gone Baby Gone

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane

Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world.

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: A cab driver realizes his current fare is a hit man that has been having him drive around from mark to mark until the last witness to a crime is dead. When the cabbie finally figures out the truth, he must prevent the assassin from wiping out his last witness without becoming the next in the professional killer's line of casualties.

William Homer (Terry-Thomas) and concocts a bizarre moneymaking plan that involves secret blueprints, international espionage and crooked dentist Dr. Pinto (John Bluthal).

When the jealous pair file for divorce, both rush into new relationships, but quickly realize their love never died. The soon-to-be-divorced husband and wife then both scramble to spoil each other's chances for newfound romance.

When Bonnie Lee (Jean Arthur), a performer who is falling for him, sees that Geoff is preparing to fly in violent weather conditions, she takes measures to make him stay. She's successful in her attempt, and two of his employees are forced to make the flight for him -- but Bonnie may have been correct about the potential peril of that flight.

programme.title: Love Has Many Faces
programme.desc: Wealthy Kit Jordon (Lana Turner) and her dissolute husband, Pete (Cliff Robertson), are in Acapulco, Mexico, when a corpse washes onto the beach. The deceased was a lover of Kit's and a friend of Pete's, so the police question the Jordans. Then the dead man's girlfriend (Stefanie Powers) arrives, and she and Pete have an affair. Luckily, Kit has her choice of men to distract her. There is gigolo Hank (Hugh O'Brian), bullfighter Julian (Carlos Montalban) and, when in a pinch, even her husband.

programme.title: Buck Clayton, Henry Chaix, Théo Siegrist & Pierre Bouru
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland. With a local rhythm section of French pianist Henry Chaix, Swiss double bassist Théo Siegrist, and Swiss drummer Pierre Bouru, this stalwart of the Count Basie Orchestra gave a sparkling performance that was documented for posterity by Radio Télévision Suisse in the program ‘Variétés'. Opening with the George Gershwin favorite ‘'S Wonderful', the program continues with two swing-era classics: ‘I Can't Get Started' and ‘Honeysuckle Rose'. Revel at how easily Clayton finishes ‘Honeysuckle Rose' on a high concert F! A spirited romp through Juan Tizol's composition ‘Perdido' closes this recording. The success of this booking ensured Clayton received repeated warm receptions in Bern in the following decades.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.sub-title: Herbie Man & Sonny Sharrock - Memphis underground
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah
programme.sub-title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks, Judith Hendricks, Kim Lindsay & Mart Ledford
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. John Carl Hendricks is one of the instigators of "vocalese", an art form that aims to add lyrics to existing instrumental pieces and replace several instruments with singing. He flaunts this technique at Estival, where he "scat" while playing double bass. Hendricks is known for his mastery of scat, a form of vocal jazz that uses onomatopoeia rather than lyrics

programme.title: West Coast All Stars
programme.sub-title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: West Coast All Stars
programme.desc: This live recording is celebrating 50 years of West Coast Jazz. The West Coast Jazz movement had its origins about 50 years ago in Los Angeles. It was essentially a "cool" form of jazz played mostly by studio musicians as a break from their studio work. The West Coast All Stars are specially brought together for this West Coast Night. The performance shows some of the most important early pioneers of this style of jazz - including legends such as Conte Candoli, Carl Fontana and Teddy Edwards. Jazz writer and critic Alun Morgan about this concert: “Altogether a very impressive experience. These guys are all real jazz pros who can turn in a masterly performance at the drop of a hat. Who said West Coast Jazz was cold and sterile? These guys can churn up enough excitement to bring any audience to its feet."

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson's virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk's enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Don Cherry, Peter Apfelbaum, Bo Freeman & Joshua Jones
programme.desc: Trumpeter Don Cherry was a musician of great versatility, creating an endless variety of styles and influencing generations of musicians. Multikulti presents a never-before heard mixture of international sounds, from mainstream jazz to reggae, in his first collaboration with the amazing Peter Apfelbaum, one of the most in-demand performers at jazz festivals all over the world.

programme.title: Silas Bjerregard, Clara Cecilie Thomsen, eee gee & Caspar Phillipson
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history. These are famous soundtracks that, for nearly a century, have made us shiver, melt, and cry in the darkness of the cinema. Christian Schumann conducts The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir and soloists are Silas Bjerregaard and eee gee with host Caspar Phillipson as special guest.

programme.title: Ana María Paño-Osorio & Philharmonie de Paris
programme.sub-title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio! Embark on a lyrical adventure with them, from the powerful drama of Bellini's I Capuleti e I Montecchi and the majestic Jerusalem by Verdi, to the boisterous and spirited cancan of Offenbach's operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Sinfonía por el Perú is a nonprofit organization founded by Juan Diego Flórez, with a mission to inspire social change through collective music education. Since its inception in 2011, over six thousand young Peruvians have embraced the opportunity to play an instrument or sing in a choir. Students from the program have graced the world's most prestigious stages, from Salzburg to Gstaad, including the Lucerne Festival, and they accompany Juan Diego Flórez for this concert.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg & Jimmy J¢rgensen
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: David Grimal & Les Dissonances
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Johannes Brahms' String Sextet No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 18. The work is scored for two violins, two violas, and two cellos. Brahms wrote his only two string sextets at the very beginning of his career. String Sextet No. 1 was written in 1860. Brahms was one of the first to compose for this ensemble, blazing a trail for Antonín Dvořák, Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky, Arnold Schoenberg, and others. This performance was recorded at Opéra de Dijon, France, in 2013.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The composer wrote the symphony between 1877 and 1878, and dedicated it to Nadezhda von Meck – an exceptionally wealthy widow and great admirer of Tchaikovsky's music, whom the composer described as ‘my best friend'. Tchaikovsky explained in his letters that the symphony is characterization of the nature of fate. The work opens with a powerful motif in the horns and bassoons representing fate. The second movement expresses melancholy, whereas the third presents ‘fleeting images that pass through the imagination when one has begun to drink a little wine'. Although the ‘fate' motif reappears toward the end of the final movement, the movement has a festive character. This performance was recorded at La Cité de la musique in Paris in 2016.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Buck Clayton, Henry Chaix, Théo Siegrist & Pierre Bouru
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland. With a local rhythm section of French pianist Henry Chaix, Swiss double bassist Théo Siegrist, and Swiss drummer Pierre Bouru, this stalwart of the Count Basie Orchestra gave a sparkling performance that was documented for posterity by Radio Télévision Suisse in the program ‘Variétés'. Opening with the George Gershwin favorite ‘'S Wonderful', the program continues with two swing-era classics: ‘I Can't Get Started' and ‘Honeysuckle Rose'. Revel at how easily Clayton finishes ‘Honeysuckle Rose' on a high concert F! A spirited romp through Juan Tizol's composition ‘Perdido' closes this recording. The success of this booking ensured Clayton received repeated warm receptions in Bern in the following decades.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.sub-title: Herbie Man & Sonny Sharrock - Memphis underground
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah
programme.sub-title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks, Judith Hendricks, Kim Lindsay & Mart Ledford
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. John Carl Hendricks is one of the instigators of "vocalese", an art form that aims to add lyrics to existing instrumental pieces and replace several instruments with singing. He flaunts this technique at Estival, where he "scat" while playing double bass. Hendricks is known for his mastery of scat, a form of vocal jazz that uses onomatopoeia rather than lyrics

programme.title: West Coast All Stars
programme.sub-title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: West Coast All Stars
programme.desc: This live recording is celebrating 50 years of West Coast Jazz. The West Coast Jazz movement had its origins about 50 years ago in Los Angeles. It was essentially a "cool" form of jazz played mostly by studio musicians as a break from their studio work. The West Coast All Stars are specially brought together for this West Coast Night. The performance shows some of the most important early pioneers of this style of jazz - including legends such as Conte Candoli, Carl Fontana and Teddy Edwards. Jazz writer and critic Alun Morgan about this concert: “Altogether a very impressive experience. These guys are all real jazz pros who can turn in a masterly performance at the drop of a hat. Who said West Coast Jazz was cold and sterile? These guys can churn up enough excitement to bring any audience to its feet."

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson's virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk's enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Don Cherry, Peter Apfelbaum, Bo Freeman & Joshua Jones
programme.desc: Trumpeter Don Cherry was a musician of great versatility, creating an endless variety of styles and influencing generations of musicians. Multikulti presents a never-before heard mixture of international sounds, from mainstream jazz to reggae, in his first collaboration with the amazing Peter Apfelbaum, one of the most in-demand performers at jazz festivals all over the world.

programme.title: Silas Bjerregard, Clara Cecilie Thomsen, eee gee & Caspar Phillipson
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history. These are famous soundtracks that, for nearly a century, have made us shiver, melt, and cry in the darkness of the cinema. Christian Schumann conducts The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir and soloists are Silas Bjerregaard and eee gee with host Caspar Phillipson as special guest.

programme.title: Ana María Paño-Osorio & Philharmonie de Paris
programme.sub-title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio! Embark on a lyrical adventure with them, from the powerful drama of Bellini's I Capuleti e I Montecchi and the majestic Jerusalem by Verdi, to the boisterous and spirited cancan of Offenbach's operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Sinfonía por el Perú is a nonprofit organization founded by Juan Diego Flórez, with a mission to inspire social change through collective music education. Since its inception in 2011, over six thousand young Peruvians have embraced the opportunity to play an instrument or sing in a choir. Students from the program have graced the world's most prestigious stages, from Salzburg to Gstaad, including the Lucerne Festival, and they accompany Juan Diego Flórez for this concert.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg & Jimmy J¢rgensen
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: David Grimal & Les Dissonances
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Johannes Brahms' String Sextet No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 18. The work is scored for two violins, two violas, and two cellos. Brahms wrote his only two string sextets at the very beginning of his career. String Sextet No. 1 was written in 1860. Brahms was one of the first to compose for this ensemble, blazing a trail for Antonín Dvořák, Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky, Arnold Schoenberg, and others. This performance was recorded at Opéra de Dijon, France, in 2013.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The composer wrote the symphony between 1877 and 1878, and dedicated it to Nadezhda von Meck – an exceptionally wealthy widow and great admirer of Tchaikovsky's music, whom the composer described as ‘my best friend'. Tchaikovsky explained in his letters that the symphony is characterization of the nature of fate. The work opens with a powerful motif in the horns and bassoons representing fate. The second movement expresses melancholy, whereas the third presents ‘fleeting images that pass through the imagination when one has begun to drink a little wine'. Although the ‘fate' motif reappears toward the end of the final movement, the movement has a festive character. This performance was recorded at La Cité de la musique in Paris in 2016.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: J Balvin
programme.desc: J. Balvin returns to his hometown of Medellín, Colombia to perform a special anniversary concert entitled "BRUUTTAL". A musical journey that begins with his early songs and ends with his most recent, multi-platinum album, " Energía.” This spectacular show was performed and filmed to express J. Balvin's gratitude to his fans. J. Balvin succeeded in making this one-time show spectacular by assembling other Latin urban music legends including Nicky Jam, Yandel, Farruko, Zion y Lennox, Jowell y Randy, among others, to join him on stage. J. Balvin sang his hit songs “6 AM,” “Safari,” “Ginza,” and “Ay Vamos.”

programme.title: El cartero (y Pablo Neruda)
